title: Quinnipiac poll: 55% of Americans say AI will do more harm than good in their day-to-day lives, and 65% oppose building data centers in their community (Emily Birnbaum/Bloomberg)
summary: Emily Birnbaum / Bloomberg: Quinnipiac poll: 55% of Americans say AI will do more harm than good in their day-to-day lives, and 65% oppose building data centers in their community — Americans are increasingly turning against artificial intelligence, with growing majorities saying they fear the fast-moving technology …
